author: J.R. Farrar
releaseNotes:
1.4.7 - HEALTH REPORTING. A Garadget can be wrong without being silent: one unit's optical sensor froze for 7 days while it stayed online and kept reporting 'closed' - including a night the door was open. The old watchdog only catches a unit that stops answering. New attribute 'health' with 'healthReason':
 - sensorFrozen: the reflection reading has not changed AT ALL for N hours (default 36) while the unit still answers. A healthy unit jitters by 1-3 points dozens of times a day even when the door never moves (3 doors x 8 weeks: longest healthy gap 19.5 h; the frozen unit 176 h).
 - commandFailed: an open/close the reflection reading did not confirm by crossing the unit's own threshold in the right direction within travel time + margin. A 'closed' status string alone is not accepted as proof.
 - offline: no answer for twice the stale window.
Also new: 'lastBoot' (unit restarted, e.g. after a power cycle - read from the unit's own uptime), 'lastCommandResult', command 'resetHealth', and preferences for the checks (on by default; can be turned off). The threshold (srt) and travel time (mtt) are read from the unit's own config.
NEW COMPANION APP: 'Garadget Guardian' (separate package in this repository) watches 'health' and power-cycles each Garadget through its own smart outlet when it is offline, frozen or fails a command, proves it restarted, and tells you what it then sees - ALERT if the door is actually open. After updating, open each Garadget device and click Save Preferences once so the 15-minute health check is scheduled.
